{"metadata":{"description":"English · 中文","id":"gh:1337978261","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-message-copy-enhance","slug":"Asianfleet/dsh-message-copy-enhance","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-message-copy-enhance"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness client UI plugin: **when you select text in a model message and copy it, the clip"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"board content is rewritten to Markdown**, so links, LaTeX source, code-fence language info, and more"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" are no longer lost."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DSH renders model output via `dsh-client-ui-conversation` → `dsh-client-ui-primitives`:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Content | DOM shape | Recovery |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Links | `<a href="...">` | Take the `href` directly, output `label` |
| Inline / block LaTeX | KaT"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"eX-rendered `.katex` / `.katex-display` | Retrieve the **TeX source** from the `<annotation encoding"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"="application/x-tex">` in the MathML branch, output `$...$` / `$$...$$` |
| Code blocks | `.md-code-"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"block` (banner shows the language) + `pre` | Output a fenced code block; the language comes from the"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" `language-*` class or the banner's infostring |
| Headings / emphasis / lists / quotes / tables | S"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"tandard HTML | Recovered as GFM |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The plugin listens for `copy` on `document` in the **capture phase**, and takes over only when the s"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"election starts inside a `[data-chat-flow-kind="assistant"]` message and contains markdown-significa"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"rts inside a `[data-chat-flow-kind="assistant"]` message and contains markdown-significant elements:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"1. Expand the selection to the full `.katex` element (selecting in the middle of a formula still get"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"s the complete source)
2. Clone the selection DOM with `Range.cloneContents()`
3. Recover the markdo"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"wn with the built-in zero-dependency DOM→Markdown converter (`src/client/toMarkdown.ts`, written in "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"TypeScript, type-erased and inlined into the bundle)
4. `preventDefault()` and write `text/plain` an"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"erased and inlined into the bundle)
4. `preventDefault()` and write `text/plain` and `text/markdown`"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Other selections (user bubbles, tool cards, plain text) and empty selections are completely unaffect"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ed; if conversion fails, the default copy behavior is restored automatically."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Project structure"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Build & test"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Release"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Releases are driven by release-it with a Conventional Commits changelog. Run from the `main` branch "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"with a clean working tree:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"It is **interactive**: first the commits since the last tag are shown as a changelog preview (groupe"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"d by type, including the conventional-commits recommended version), then you pick the next version f"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"rom a prompt (`patch` / `minor` / `major` / pre-release variants / custom). What happens, in order:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. **Checks** (`npm run check:release`): version is valid SemVer, the version is not already publish"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ed on npm (or there are new commits since its tag), `GITHUB_TOKEN` is set, npm is authenticated; the"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"n typecheck and the test suite run.
2. **Prompt** — the changelog preview is printed and the next ve"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"rsion is chosen interactively (the recommended bump from conventional commits is shown; `feat` → min"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"or, `fix`/`perf`/`revert` → patch, breaking changes → major).
3. **Changelog** — `CHANGELOG.md` is r"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"egenerated from the commits since the last tag, under the chosen version.
4. **Build** — `npm run bu"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"ild` (the DSH module-loader client bundle).
5. **Release** — commit `chore(release): vX.Y.Z`, tag `v"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"X.Y.Z`, push to GitHub, create a GitHub Release (release notes from the changelog), then `npm publis"},{"id":"p19s9","text":".Z`, push to GitHub, create a GitHub Release (release notes from the changelog), then `npm publish`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Prerequisites:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- `GITHUB_PAT_TOKEN` exported (a GitHub PAT — a classic token with `repo` scope, or a fine-grained t"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"oken with **Contents: Read and write** on this repo; `gh auth token` also works; `GITHUB_TOKEN` is a"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ccepted as a fallback), and `npm login`. The collaborator pre-check is skipped (`github.skipChecks`)"},{"id":"p21s4","text":", since fine-grained tokens get a 403 on that endpoint; GitHub still enforces the real permissions w"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"hen the release is created.
- Commits following Conventional Commits; the script only recognizes tho"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"elease is created.
- Commits following Conventional Commits; the script only recognizes those types."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Useful variants:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Note: if a `CI` environment variable is set, release-it automatically switches to non-interactive mo"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"e: if a `CI` environment variable is set, release-it automatically switches to non-interactive mode."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Upgrading"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"This package is pre-1.0, and a caret range like `^0.1.0` covers **patch releases only** (`0.1.x`) — "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"a **minor** bump (`0.1 → 0.2`) falls outside the range, so `dsh plugin update` will not pick it up. "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"Upgrade explicitly with `@latest` (or `@<version>`)."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**Select** content in any model answer and press `Ctrl/Cmd+C`, then paste into Typora / Obsidian / V"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"S Code / any markdown editor to get the full markdown."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- Selections **spanning multiple messages** are not intercepted (only selections starting inside an "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"assistant message are handled).
- Links filtered out by the render whitelist (e.g. `file:`, relative"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" links) have no `href` to begin with and cannot be recovered.
- Code blocks only recover the **selec"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"ted lines** (no forced expansion of the whole block); the language tag is missing when the selected "},{"id":"p33s5","text":"region does not include the banner.
- Elements shown as `.katex-error` (KaTeX render failure) are ou"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"tput as `$source$`.
- Tables are output as GFM pipe tables; `|` is escaped."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"MIT — Copyright (c) 2026 Asianfleet"}],"truncated":false}
